notes: **Three domains (Woese, 1990):** Archaea (primitive prokaryotes, extremophiles), Bacteria (true bacteria), Eukarya (eukaryotes). Based on rRNA sequencing.
**Binomial nomenclature (Linnaeus, 1753):** each species has a two-part scientific name: Genus + species. Italicised, Genus capitalised, species lowercase. Example: Homo sapiens.

**Five kingdoms (Whittaker, 1969):** Monera (prokaryotes), Protista (unicellular eukaryotes), Fungi (heterotrophic absorbers), Plantae (autotrophic multicellular), Animalia (heterotrophic multicellular). Basis: cell structure, nutrition, body organisation, phylogeny.
